templateDescription.frameKpiCard: Shows one important number, with a small label above and a note below (for example: Progress 17.93%).

templateDescription.frameTitledSection: A bordered area with a dark heading bar on top. Put related content inside it.
templateDescription.framePhotoCard: A photo with a caption and a date line underneath.
templateDescription.framePageBorder: A border around every page of the report.

reportParts.noBand: This report has no {band}. Turn it on under Page Settings → Band Selection, then add it again.

description.partReportHeader: A dark banner across the top of every page with three lines of title (client and project, report number, month). Goes in the Page Header.
description.partPageFooter: A thin line, the page number (Page 1 of 12) and a spot for your logo, at the bottom of every page. Goes in the Page Footer.
description.partSectionHeading: A large bold heading with its number, for example: SECTION 1.  PROJECT DETAILS.
description.partSubHeading: A smaller bold, underlined heading, for example: TOWER A: KEY ACTIVITIES.
description.partNote: A small italic line for a source or remark under a table.
description.partRiskLegend: Green, amber and red dots that explain the risk colours: Low, Moderate and High Risk.
description.partStatusDot: One coloured dot that shows a status. Pick green, amber or red in its properties.
description.partSignOff: A signature picture over a line, with the name, job title and date.
description.tableKeyValue: A heading across the top, then one row per fact: a bold label and its value (for example: Land Owner, Contract Sum).
description.tableFinancial: Description and amount, with a shaded subtotal row and a total row at the bottom.
description.tableProgress: Item, description, target %, actual % and variance %, with an Overall row at the bottom.
description.tableComparison: Two heading rows (Current, Previous and Difference, each split into Issued and Pending), category rows and a Total row.
description.tableActionPlan: Item, description, the actions as bullet points, and a coloured status dot: change the dot's text colour to green, amber or red.
description.tableRiskRegister: Numbered issues with their actions, the next action, a due date and a coloured risk cell (High, Moderate).
description.partContentsList: A table of contents: number, title, dotted line and page. Use it on a contents page (or any normal page, not on the cover). Fill it from your Section Headings in its properties.
description.coverPhotoPanel: A whole cover page: photos on the left, a dark panel with logo and title.
description.coverFullPhoto: A whole cover page: one large photo and a dark title band.
description.coverMinimal: A whole cover page: logo, large title and an accent line.
description.coverColourBlock: A whole cover page: a coloured top half with the title and a photo below.
description.coverProjectCard: A whole cover page: a centred card with the title and key facts.
